title: Shared Task: Lexical Semantic Change Detection in German
answer_short: The output of a system is compared to the gold ranking of the DURel data set using Spearman's ρ as the metric.
answer_rationale: Evaluation is performed by comparing the system's predicted word rankings with the gold standard rankings from the DURel dataset, using Spearman's rank-order correlation (ρ) as the metric to measure performance. Higher Spearman's ρ indicates better alignment with the gold standard.
